why: The cards are about a place name (Well of the Serpent) and Leviathan, a fleeing or coiling serpent that God defeats. None of the sources explain these uses. The BSB footnote only mentions 'Dragon or Jackal' and a Hebrew word tannin in a different passage. Schaff's entry on the 'fiery flying serpent' is a different phrase. So no meaning can be written from the sources.
